title: Queued notification delivery
purpose: Show API/worker decoupling, independent channel queues, metadata/cache and failed-send retry path with deduplication caveat.
alt: 채널별 큐와 작업 서버로 분리한 알림 처리, 메타데이터 조회 및 전송 실패 재시도 경로
requiredChecks: Producers→Notification API; API validates/authenticates and separately accesses Metadata DB and Metadata cache.
Four separate APNs/FCM/SMS/Email queues feed matching worker pools, which call matching providers and endpoints.
Failure from worker delivery returns through Retry queue to corresponding channel queue; no retry arrow from successful user delivery.
Caption mentions event-ID deduplication; no guaranteed exactly-once delivery, all labels legible.
